ambient: Something is decided at the far end and carried out.
A voice reaches you at the volume of a voice across a field.
description: A room seen from the wrong end of the length of it. Everything that's happening is happening at the other end, correctly, at the right size for where it is. Your hands are down there too, doing something competent.
name: The Far End

looks: A room. Ordinary. Full size, from where it's standing.
The people in it are managing without any input.
It gets no closer and it isn't going away.
objects.name: the far end

looks: They're yours. You could describe every mark on them from here.
They stop, and wait, and aren't waiting on you.
objects.name: your hands

weather: Thin. The air of somewhere high, where sound arrives late.
